verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser documents a dedicated startups/entrepreneurs immigration practice and an O-1 practice page, so representing founders on visa matters is a core service. However, nothing in the pack describes end-to-end petition preparation. The Visalaw AI drafting and exhibit-list prompts belong to a separate software product for immigration teams, not to the firm preparing a founder's petition, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented evidence-binder assembly, expert and support letter drafting/solicitation, forms preparation, filing handled by the firm, and any independent or client corroboration of the end-to-end service.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider prepares the petition end to end — evidence binder, expert and support letters, forms, and filing — documented as its core service

citations.quote: Siskind Susser attorneys are experts in finding creative visa solutions for entrepreneurs.
